items.title: Judge's question for the GM follows the selection
items.do: As the GM, the Orc Warrior attacks Aveline next to Durgan (Judged Orc); when Judge's question comes, click the empty map, then Durgan's token; then deselect Durgan and select him again; answer it.
items.expect: Each time Durgan is selected, his HUD opens with the question in its Situational tab (not the large bar); deselected, the question waits in the HUD's middle; the map click releases the Orc as usual.

items.title: The Encounter Log: numbered names
items.do: In a fight with two Goblin Sneaks where only one deals damage, and Sylwen's Volley hits Aveline; open the Encounter Log, copy it.
items.expect: The legend reads "GS2 - Goblin Sneak 2" and "GS1 - Goblin Sneak 1"; the damage table and the copy read "Goblin Sneak 2" (not "Goblin Sneak") and "Sylwen" (not "Sylwen (Elf Archer, Quick Shots)"), with Sylwen's damage to Aveline as "to allies".
